what: entity extraction reads declaration keywords (fn/struct/impl/trait/enum, def/class, function, func, Java visibility) only where the text is code
note: Entity extraction runs when a record is inserted (auto-linking to _entities, the importance entity bonus) and for `recall --expand`. A recall eval over a fixed snapshot reads the entities stored when the snapshot was written, so it cannot show the change; it is recorded to show that nothing else moved. The re-extraction counts and the rebuilt-database eval are the measurements of the change itself.

before.source: 2108d82 + the MCP tool-profile change (no extraction change)

re_extraction.corpus: the 232 user records (commits 100, context 40, decisions 63, errors 27, rules 2) of snap-prefix, text as auto-linking reads it (searchable_text), at most 50 entities per record as auto-linking keeps
re_extraction.method: a scratch program linking entity.rs at 2108d82 (before) and at 1c7f12d (after)

rebuilt_db_dogfood.method: `axil export` the same 232 user records (ids and timestamps kept; stored _importance stripped so it is recomputed, pinned importance kept), `axil import` each into a fresh `axil init` database with the before and the after binary (insert-time importance and auto-linking run with that binary's extraction), then run the dogfood eval on each without --snapshot. The rebuilt databases hold no code index or SCIP entities, so their absolute numbers are not comparable with the snapshot eval; only before vs after is.
